text:

subject: Training data pipeline for perception model
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've just onboarded Mytra (inventory robotics co) away from CAVT to help them scale their real-world data collection for perception models. They moved to our platform at a time where their data volume surged (as they were moving from simulation to real world testing and CVAT's frame-based limitation was slowing them down).

How are you thinking about perception training data at [COMPANY] Labs? I'm flexible afternoon times PT if you're up for a chat.

subject: Scaling ML data operation for AirCover
text:
Hi [NAME],

Seems like you look after data operations for the AirCover team at [COMPANY].
Wanted to introduce ourselves since we just onboarded Onfido (Entrust) for
a similar multimodal evidence/ identity verification use case.

Typically enterprises (e.g. Onfido and AXA) building models for high-stake
applications like insurance and fraud detection move to Encord from
open-source/first-gen tools (e.g. LabelStudio & Labelbox) for better
scalability on complex labelling projects.

   documents and text)
   - Workflow visibility on multi-step human-in-the-loop projects (e.g.
   model-assisted pre-labelling -> consensus -> quality control etc)
   - Analytics and label versioning to monitor productivity and consistency

How are you thinking about scaling data operations for Aircover? Flexible
morning times PT if you're open to a chat.
